text:
Alex R.: Heads up — we need to lock the console/docs changes for the 0.29.0 cut. Cutoff is today 17:00 PDT. If you have a changelog entry or any last-minute console copy tweaks, drop them now.
Maria G.: Quick Q — do we need an SDK docs regen for the client v0.29.0 bump? I have a tiny transport fix that will land after noon.
Alex R.: Yes, regen required because the API surface changed (client.signature.* renamed). Plan: regen in staging, smoke the site, then deploy. Sam, can you run the SDK docs job after your PR merges?
Sam T.: Yep. I can do the regen. Will wait for CI then run: `yarn docs:regen && yarn docs:build && make docs-deploy TARGET=staging`
Jen L.: Changelog: I added a brief note about the transport fix under "bugfixes". Alex — do we want to squash it into the 0.29.0 highlights or leave it in bugfixes?
Alex R.: Leave in bugfixes. It's not user-facing. Also bump package.json version in console repo to 0.29.0-rc.1, then we'll promote.
Maria G.: Will the release pipeline tag automatically? Or should I create the release branch now?
Alex R.: We'll create release/0.29.0 after cutoff. For staging regen: tag not needed. For prod deploy pipeline we need an rc tag.
release-bot: CI: build/console-main #482 succeeded (sha: a1b2c3d) :white_check_mark:
Sam T.: PR merged. Running regen now. Pasting commands I'm using:
```
git checkout -b regen/docs/sdk-0.29
git pull origin main
yarn install --frozen-lockfile
yarn docs:regennyarn docs:build --site=console
make docs-deploy TARGET=staging
```
Alex R.: Thanks — after deploy, please smoke test these routes: /docs/api/auth, /docs/guides/deploy, and the SDK quickstart. Verify code samples show the new client.signature field.
Sam T.: Staging deploy done. Minor CSS flashing on mobile TOC — filing a tiny follow-up PR. All samples show client.signature.
Maria G.: I pushed a tiny docs wording tweak to console copy, and added the changelog entry to the changelog.md file.
Jen L.: Reminder: version bump in dashboards repo too? We changed a widget prop earlier.
Alex R.: Good catch — bump dashboards to 0.29.0-rc.1 as well. I'll open the release branch once the UI widget PR merges.
Maria G.: Anyone want me to run the QA smoke checklist? I can run through the quickstart and SDK snippets once staging is stable.
Alex R.: Please do — start at 18:00 PDT. If anything blocks, ping here and add the `release-blocker` tag on the PR.
release-bot: Deploy: docs-staging -> success (url: https://staging.docs.redwood-inference.com) :rocket:
Sam T.: QA smoke started. All good so far except the mobile TOC flicker — non-blocking for release.
Jen L.: CSS fix PR submitted and linked to the release branch.
Alex R.: Cool. Final checklist for cutoff: 1) all changelog entries merged, 2) console + dashboards version bumps in, 3) SDK docs regen completed and staged, 4) QA smoke green. If we hit all four, we cut release/0.29.0 at 19:00 PDT and tag rc.
Maria G.: Acknowledged. I'll post a short note in #all-hands after the tag. :thumbsup:
Sam T.: All green from smoke. Ready to cut.
Alex R.: Cutting release branch now. Creating tag 0.29.0-rc.1 and kicking prod pipeline — will report status here.
release-bot: Release: 0.29.0-rc.1 created (branch: release/0.29.0) by Alex R.
Alex R.: Prod pipeline started. If you see any sudden errors, alert eng-oncall and ping me. Thanks for the fast turnaround, team! :tada:
